verification_note: Instrument titles and years are seed metadata compiled for routing. Section numbers, sub-clauses, thresholds and penalty amounts are deliberately absent and must be populated only from the whitelisted primary sources below by a reviewer before this file is marked VERIFIED.

obligations.summary: Incorporation, name reservation and constitutional documents are filed with the Registrar of Companies through the MCA portal.
Statutory registers, board minutes and annual filings must be maintained on an ongoing basis.
Issue and allotment of securities, including to founders and investors, is a regulated filing event.
Multi-class cap tables, convertible instruments and ESOP pools interact with securities rules.
LLP incorporation and the LLP agreement are filed with the Registrar.
Annual return and statement of account and solvency filings are recurring obligations.

instruments.title: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023
instruments.authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

obligations.summary: Personal data processing is built around notice and a lawful basis; product surfaces must expose that notice.
Mechanisms for access, correction, erasure and grievance redressal must exist in the product.
Processing personal data of children carries heightened restrictions.
Classification as a Significant Data Fiduciary attaches additional governance duties.
Transfer of personal data outside India is subject to government restriction and must be assessed instrument by instrument.
Personal data breaches carry notification duties to the Board and affected principals.

instruments.commencement_note: Provisions and subordinate rules commence by notification; the operative date for each duty must be confirmed against the Gazette before it is relied upon.

instruments.title: Information Technology Act, 2000
instruments.authority: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

obligations.summary: Platforms that host third-party content must determine their intermediary status and the due-diligence conditions attached to it.
Bodies corporate handling sensitive personal data are expected to maintain reasonable security practices.
Cyber-incident reporting and log-retention directions issued under this framework apply to service providers.

instruments.title: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
instruments.authority: Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs

obligations.summary: Registration is threshold- and activity-driven and is state-wise, not national.
Tax invoices and periodic returns are recurring compliance events.
Supplies across multiple states create separate state registrations and place-of-supply analysis.
Acting as an electronic commerce operator collecting on behalf of sellers attaches distinct duties.
Permanent Account Number and, where withholding applies, Tax Deduction Account Number are prerequisites to operating.
Payments to contractors, employees and non-residents may attract withholding obligations.
Employee stock option taxation interacts with vesting design and must be modelled with an adviser.

instruments.title: Code on Wages, 2019

obligations.summary: Wage payment, minimum wage and wage-period rules apply to employed persons.

instruments.commencement_note: Labour code commencement and the corresponding state rules are notified separately; the applicable instrument in a given state may still be the predecessor Act. Confirm before relying on this entry.

instruments.title: Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952

obligations.summary: Establishment coverage is headcount- and activity-driven; registration and monthly contribution follow coverage.
Coverage depends on headcount, wage ceiling and whether the area is implemented for ESI.

instruments.title: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace (Prevention, Prohibition and Redressal) Act, 2013
instruments.authority: Ministry of Women and Child Development

obligations.summary: Workplaces above the prescribed employee count must constitute an internal committee and publish a policy.
Inbound foreign investment carries pricing, sectoral and reporting conditions.
Holding or routing customer funds, escrow and payment aggregation are separately regulated activities.

instruments.title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
instruments.authority: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

obligations.summary: Consumer-facing digital commerce carries disclosure, grievance-officer and unfair-trade-practice constraints.

instruments.title: Copyright Act, 1957
instruments.authority: Copyright Office, Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade

obligations.summary: Copyright in code, designs, copy and other works vests first in their author. The company owns them only through a written assignment or a qualifying employment relationship.
Use of third-party works — datasets, media, catalogues, open-source components — requires a licence whose scope covers the actual use, including any downstream distribution.
A platform hosting user uploads must operate a working notice-and-takedown route and a published grievance contact to be treated as an intermediary rather than as the publisher.

instruments.title: Trade Marks Act, 1999
instruments.authority: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks

obligations.summary: A product or company name should be cleared against the register and against existing traders in the same class before it is used in commerce; registration of a company name is not a trade-mark right.
Registration is applied for in the classes of goods or services actually traded in, and is maintained on its own renewal cycle.

instruments.title: Patents Act, 1970
instruments.authority: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trade Marks

obligations.summary: Patentable subject matter is limited, and public disclosure before filing can defeat an application. Whether a software or business-method invention qualifies is a question for a practitioner, not an assumption.
Filing abroad first, from India, is a regulated route with its own permission requirement.

An agreement is enforceable only if the essentials are present: capacity, free consent, lawful object and consideration. A founder arrangement recorded only in chat or email is frequently unenforceable on its terms.

An agreement restraining a person from exercising a lawful profession, trade or business is void in India to that extent. A post-employment non-compete drafted to a foreign template is generally unenforceable here, and relying on it as protection is the error.
Indemnity, limitation of liability and termination rights are the clauses that decide what a dispute costs. They are negotiated, not boilerplate.

instruments.title: Indian Stamp Act, 1899 (read with the applicable State Stamp Act)
instruments.authority: Department of Revenue / State Registration and Stamps Department

obligations.summary: Stamp duty is payable on the instrument, at the rate of the state where it is executed, and the rate differs by state for the same document. Duty must be paid before or at execution, not afterwards.

An insufficiently stamped instrument is not admissible in evidence until the duty and penalty are paid. A signed agreement that cannot be produced in court is, for practical purposes, no agreement at all.
Most states now require e-stamping through the authorised vendor rather than physical stamp paper, and franking rules vary by state.

Certain instruments — notably leases of immovable property beyond the prescribed term — must be registered, and an unregistered instrument in that class does not affect the property or work as evidence of the transaction.

An arbitration clause must name the seat, the number of arbitrators, the appointing mechanism and the language. A clause naming only 'arbitration in India' generates a preliminary dispute about the dispute.
Seat of arbitration and governing law are separate choices with separate consequences, and a cross-border contract needs both stated deliberately.

Dishonour of a cheque for insufficiency of funds is prosecutable, but only if the statutory notice is issued within the prescribed window after the return memo. Missing that window forfeits the remedy entirely.

instruments.title: Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development Act, 2006
instruments.authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises

obligations.summary: Udyam registration is free, self-declared, and is the gateway to public-procurement set-asides, subsidised credit and several state incentives.

A buyer must pay a registered micro or small supplier within the statutory period. Overdue amounts attract compounded interest that cannot be contracted out of, and the deduction of the expense can be disallowed for tax.
